name: DialUpSoundz
tagline: Your own layer over Apple Music: your playlists, your ratings, your next favorite album. Your own listening history put to work.
summary: Paste the list your chat assistant gives you. DialUpSoundz finds every song on Apple Music, shows you what it matched, and saves the playlist to your library or plays it right away. That part is free. A one-time Data Layer unlock turns it into your own layer over Apple Music: ratings, tags and liner notes, playlists of songs and whole albums, Listen Later lists, recommendations from the Operator, and your data to export and import, all kept on your iPhone.
statusLabel: Coming soon to the App Store
stepsHeading: From a chat to a playlist

steps.title: Talk it through in your chat app
steps.body: Copy the DialUpSoundz prompt into a chat with your assistant. It works with chat assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Talk about moods, eras, deep cuts and what to leave out, then ask for the list.

steps.title: Paste the list
steps.body: Copy the reply and paste it into DialUpSoundz. A plain list such as Artist - Song, one per line, works too.

steps.title: Review the matches
steps.body: Each song, artist or album is looked up on Apple Music. Anything that needs a look is marked, and you can swap versions, preview, reorder or remove.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Nothing is saved until you tap Save. The playlist goes to your Apple Music library with its name and description, and stays in the Playlists tab.

features.title: Playlists from a chat
features.body: Original studio versions are preferred over live, karaoke and cover versions, unless you asked for those. Save it, or play it right here with AirPlay.

features.title: Album lists
features.body: Ask for whole albums instead of songs, and DialUpSoundz matches each one to the album on Apple Music.

features.title: Your own playlists
features.body: Tag songs and whole albums into playlists from their pages, or search Apple Music and your library to add them. Import your Apple Music playlists, view any playlist by album, and save back to Apple Music when you want. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Rate fast
features.body: Work through your most played albums and songs, what you've heard from Listen Later, an artist's records, or anything on Apple Music, with a preview to remind you how it sounds: stars, love or not, your own tags, and liner notes. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Ask the Operator
features.body: Set up your chat assistant once with your ratings and listening, then ask for music that fits your taste, a playlist like one of yours, or research on an album to keep with it. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Your data, yours to keep
features.body: Browse your listening history, Listen Later lists and ratings, play any combination of tags like a playlist, look inside the JSON, and export or import all of it. The history and charts are early and growing. With the Data Layer.
